listing_title: Appartamento Bilocale al Piano Terra - A Jesolo — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / PROPERTIES / APPARTAMENTO BILOCALE AL PIANO TERRA - A JESOLO FOR SALE · APARTMENT Appartamento Bilocale al Piano Terra - A Jesolo LIDO DI JESOLO · JESOLO · VENEZIA PRICE €310,000 Photos (14) Floor plans (1) 1 / 14 FLOOR AREA 50 m² BEDROOMS 1 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS B Overview Welcome to your new home in Jesolo Lido! Located in a privileged position just 150 meters from the beach and near Piazza Milano, we offer for sale a ground floor two-room apartment situated in a small condominium of only 6 units, ensuring tranquility and privacy. Through a private gate, you access the exclusive outdoor area, an ideal space for al fresco dining, enhanced by a motorized awning with wind sensor that guarantees shade, privacy, and safety. From here you enter directly into the cozy living room with kitchenette, bright and functional—the heart of the home. A hallway leads to the windowed bathroom with shower and to the spacious master bedroom where a custom-made wall has created an additional room with bunk beds: an intelligent solution that provides more sleeping spaces and greater privacy. The bedroom also features access to a small reserved terrace. Completing the property is an assigned private parking space, always available and very convenient during the summer season. The radiator heating system makes this residence ideal not only for summer vacations but also for year-round stays, offering enjoyment of the sea even in winter. A ready-to-live-in apartment perfect as a second home by the sea or as an investment opportunity in one of Jesolo Lido's most sought-after and vibrant areas.
